review.rationale: The Decision correctly applies TITMAS-CS-STANDING-001 to the exact bounded five-path status reconciliation. It preserves the frozen evidence of PR #27 merge, post-merge validation, and the already-completed External Agent First Run without re-execution. The five target paths are strictly scoped, historical failures are preserved, and the next gate is correctly limited to preparing the CE-G12 Recommendation only. All non-authorizations (deployment, release, standard ready, production ready, commercial offering, certification, etc.) are explicitly false and capped at zero. The validation contract and stop conditions are sufficient and fail-closed. The qualifying qwen3.7-max Recommendation review confirms the soundness of the scope, evidence, and boundary preservation. No false authority or commercial effects are introduced.
